note: 0.3.1 adventurer-class AI players (personas with class 'adventurer' in data/personas.json). They play like a real player: train Attack/Strength/Defence/Vitality/Prayer with the same combat formulas, eat, pray, bank (their stash), pick the best XP/loot target for their level from data/enemies.json (generic: any enemy kind with camps), keep a best-in-slot list by stats and level requirements and buy upgrades from the Exchange, the shops or your player shop, or commission a smith. population = how many of each sub-type spawn (ids adv_0.. after the 40). start = [min,max] combat levels at spawn. session_hours = how long they play per game day (schedule 'any' = always on, so they still rest in sessions). Target choice: utility = xp_weight x XP/tick + loot_weight x loot marks/tick - food cost; a target is safe when expected damage per kill <= safe_damage_share x max HP + safe_food_share x food heals and its level <= combat level + level_margin. scorch_min_level = combat level from which a sub-type will hunt camps inside a PK zone (99 = never). Raiders raid from raid_min_level with gear. Commissions: when no source in town sells the upgrade, the agent asks a smith there at reference x commission_premium; a smith with the level fills it from its stash (or buys the bars) within commission_ticks.
